stories.title: Trump threatens to block Bombardier jet sales in the US unless production moves stateside
stories.reason: The threat lands hours before Canada's retaliatory tariffs on $20 billion of US goods take effect, escalating the trade war just as Quebec's premier vows government support for the aircraft maker.

stories.title: Hurricane Lowell menaces Hawaii with life-threatening surf and 120 mph winds
stories.reason: A state of emergency and National Guard activation are in effect as the storm passes near Kauai and Niihau, threatening up to 14 inches of rain, flash flooding and dangerous coastal inundation.

stories.title: Duterte impeachment trial reveals 37 recipients of her confidential funds were already dead
stories.reason: Philippine statistics records show one supposed informant had been dead for 61 years and another was a two-month-old baby, deepening the corruption case against the sitting vice president.

stories.title: Adobe names Anil Chakravarthy as CEO, succeeding Shantanu Narayen after 18 years
stories.reason: Chakravarthy takes over December 1 tasked with leading Adobe's fight against AI-native rivals eating into its creative-software dominance, while Narayen moves to executive chair.

stories.title: CISA flags actively exploited authentication bypass in LiteLLM's AI gateway
stories.reason: The flaw lets attackers access AI tooling with a fabricated bearer token and no valid credentials, and with over 80,000 internet-facing LiteLLM systems exposed, federal agencies face a September 16 patch deadline.

stories.title: Nvidia's AI equity investment portfolio hits $99 billion, up from $7 billion a year ago
stories.reason: Roughly half the stake is in frontier labs like OpenAI and Anthropic, illustrating how Nvidia is using its chip profits to lock in demand and influence across nearly every layer of the AI stack.

stories.title: Chip stocks rally as investors bet on demand from OpenAI's new GPT-6 Astra model
stories.reason: Micron rose 6%, Marvell 7% and Sandisk nearly 12% as markets priced in fresh AI-driven chip demand even as broader indexes slipped on Middle East-driven oil price worries.

stories.title: Australian consumer sentiment sinks as fuel prices rebound and rate-hike fears grow
stories.reason: The Westpac-Melbourne Institute sentiment index fell 5.2% to 84.4, showing how Iran-war-driven oil prices are squeezing household confidence well beyond the US and Gulf region.
